o: El 20 de marzo de este año, los vecinos de un pueblo del Chaco santafecino persiguieron a un hombre rabioso que en pos de descargar su escopeta contra su mujer, mató de un tiro a un peón que cruzaba delante de él.
t: On March 20 of this year, the neighbors of a town in the Chaco of Santa Fe chased a rabid man who, in the act of discharging his shotgun against his wife, shot dead a laborer who was crossing in front of him.

o: Los vecinos, armados, lo rastrearon en el monte como a una fiera, hallándolo por fin trepado en un árbol, con su escopeta aún, y aullando de un modo horrible.
t: The neighbors, armed, tracked him through the woods like a wild beast, finally finding him climbed up a tree, still holding his shotgun, and howling horribly.

o: Viéronse en la necesidad de matarlo de un tiro.
t: They found themselves compelled to shoot him dead.
